# Register the benchmark component.
# esp-dl is pulled via idf_component.yml. monitor_params.{c,h}, testset.{c,h} and testset_x.bin are
# generated by code/export_monitor.py and code/export_testset.py; model/model.espdl by
# code/convert_espdl.py --with-features (two outputs: logits + the 64-d pooled features).
idf_component_register(
    SRCS "qsentry_bench.cpp" "monitor_params.c" "testset.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    REQUIRES driver esp_timer esp-dl
    EMBED_FILES "model/model.espdl" "testset_x.bin"
)
